div.div: 4 آرَيْتُ الدَّابَّةَ I joined the beast to another beast, and made it to keep with the other to one manger: (S, in the present art.; and K:) or آرَيْتُ الدَّابَّتَيْنِ I joined the two beasts together, and made them both keep to one manger. (So accord. to the S in art. وأر.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
